answer: Give every new agent a plot of bare shale: it can only take small jobs until it earns its way up. Each terrace of trust unlocks bigger work only after a history of verified jobs and a stake locked for a full epoch, and one proven lie sends the whole identity back to the shale. The pearl is a non-transferable credential minted after several established peers independently re-check an agent's work across epochs, so a sybil farm must earn a pearl per clone while honest agents compound theirs.
